name: Kyriel
tagline: The command platform for congregations at scale.
positioning: Kyriel unifies membership, giving, and multi-campus operations into one governed system of record for enterprise faith organizations.

hero.h1: Every soul accounted for. Every campus in concert.
hero.sub: Kyriel is the enterprise nerve center for the modern ministry — governing membership, generosity, and operations across every location, service, and season from a single ordained source of truth.

features.title: Unified People Ledger
features.description: Retire the tangle of spreadsheets and legacy CRMs. Every attendee, volunteer, and household lives in one governed record spanning all campuses.

features.title: Consecrated Giving Engine
features.description: Reconcile pledges, recurring tithes, and capital campaigns to the cent, with audit trails your finance committee and external auditors will trust.

features.title: Multi-Campus Command
features.description: Orchestrate service schedules, room bookings, and staff assignments across fifty locations as fluidly as one, with real-time capacity dashboards.

features.title: Sovereign Data Governance
features.description: Role-based access, retention policies, and regional data residency built for denominations answerable to boards, elders, and regulators alike.

features.title: Pastoral Care Signals
features.description: Surface the member who slipped from three services to none. Kyriel flags at-risk households before they quietly leave the pews.

features.title: Assembly Analytics
features.description: Attendance rhythms, engagement cohorts, and generosity forecasts rendered in board-ready reports, not raw exports.

testimonials.quote: We migrated four disconnected systems across nine campuses into Kyriel in a single quarter. For the first time our elders and finance team read from the same ledger.
testimonials.name: Miriam Calloway

testimonials.quote: The pastoral care signals alone justified the investment. We reconnected with over 300 drifting families in our first year on the platform.
testimonials.name: Rev. Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: Auditors used to dread our year-end. Kyriel's giving reconciliation turned a three-week ordeal into an afternoon. It changed how our board sees us.
testimonials.name: Angela Reyes

pricing.blurb: For single-campus congregations establishing their first system of record.
For multi-campus organizations governing membership and generosity at scale.
For denominations and networks with sovereign data and compliance mandates.

homepage.footerBlurb: Kyriel is the enterprise platform of record for faith organizations governing membership, generosity, and operations across every campus and generation.
